fieldValues.title: An agent checks its own environment before it trusts a result
fieldValues.move: Every agent session opens with one preflight that prints what the agent would otherwise assume: the identity of the srs build in use (not the version string), whether the clone is shallow, whether sibling checkouts match origin, and which attribution variables are set. A result that depends on one of these is not reported as evidence until the preflight is clean, and a failed create call names the real cause and the allowed input.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Making the builds themselves self-identifying (a tool change), or the inconsistent create contracts across entity kinds (SP-26); the preflight only makes the disagreement visible.
fieldValues.falsifier: An agent reports a false green or a wrong history conclusion that a preflight run in that session would have flagged, or a preflight fails to flag a stale build, a shallow clone or a stale sibling that the session then hit.

fieldValues.return_when: When agent sessions have run for two weeks with the preflight and the owner has said whether any false green or wrong conclusion slipped past it.
